shots.camera: straight-on flat spec layout, product shown small at a slight 3/4 angle in the upper-right, spec card lower-left
shots.lighting: even flat warm 4300K board light, minimal soft shadow, one diffused card shadow falling left
shots.background: cream #FFF6F4 card on a mint #CFE8E1 board
shots.whitespace: generous card margins, blank value slots
shots.textZone: centred headline, five coral-rose field chips down the left of the card, blank value slots to the right
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce specification card screen of {product}. Preserve the exact product identity from the reference image: shape, silhouette, proportions, color, material, surface finish, label/logo placement, and visible construction details. Do not redesign the product. Do not add, remove, or relocate any product feature. Keep the label text exactly legible and unchanged; do not redraw or restyle any logo. {style_lock}. Straight-on flat layout on a cream #FFF6F4 card over a mint #CFE8E1 board: the printed mask shown small at a slight 3/4 angle in the upper right, and a neat five-row spec table beneath it, each row a coral-rose #EE6E85 rounded field-name chip followed by an empty blank value slot with a thin warm grey #E7E1DB underline, no value filled in, reserved for verified real data to be composited in post. Even flat warm 4300K light, one diffused card shadow falling left. Headline in #2E4F5A at 32pt reading 「{selling_point_1}」 with one line at 15pt reading 「{selling_point_2}」. Five field chips with cream #FFF6F4 labels at 15pt reading 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」「{callout_5}」, covering product name, main fabric, colourway, size and everyday use. Product occupies 30-35% of frame. Negative: do NOT invent any figure, size, piece count, shelf life, grade code, standard code, percentage, laboratory number, test report or certification mark; no readable certificate text; no medical or surgical wording; no pathogen or virus claim; no filtration or antimicrobial efficacy wording; no clinical setting or healthcare worker; no people; no QR code, membership badge, contact block or price; no mixed fonts; no garbled Chinese characters; no dense body text; no watermark.
shots.negativePrompt: no invented figure, size, piece count, shelf life, code, percentage or lab number; no test report or certification mark; no medical or surgical wording; no pathogen or virus claim; no efficacy wording; no clinical setting or healthcare worker; no people; no QR code, badge, contact block or price; no mixed fonts; no garbled Chinese characters; no dense body text; no watermark.

shots.title: 使用须知收口
shots.intent: 以四条佩戴与存放须知加一枚短按钮收口，完成提醒与加购转化而不依赖任何资质承诺。

shots.lighting: even high-key warm 4300K light, soft front-right key, clean contact shadow falling left
shots.background: misty pink #F8D3D8 board with a raised cream #FFF6F4 reminder card and a mint #CFE8E1 footer band
shots.textZone: headline at the top, four short reminder lines on the card, one rounded coral-rose button beneath

provenance.notes: 12 张详情页切片（源夹标为「口罩2」）判读真实主体：白色平纹三折一次性印花口罩，满版小熊与草莓卡通印花（奶白 #FBF8F4 底、蜜橘小熊、树莓红草莓），细圆松紧耳带、上折内藏单根鼻梁丝、侧边超声点焊，配粉色小盒与自封袋；产品信息栏自陈品名为「一次性印花口罩」、主材 PP 无纺布、三层为水刺布/熔喷布/无纺布，面向家庭与儿童日常佩戴。视觉体系为糖果粉＋薄荷绿＋奶油白的圆角色块看板、白描边内嵌留图框、实心圆形图标与圆体字。归类说明：源盒面印有「一次性使用 医用外科」字样与 30P 件数，但实物为日用印花平面三层口罩（非 3D 立体柳叶款、非折叠杯式、非带阀半面罩、非防晒保暖面罩），且健康合规要求不得呈现医疗与外科用途，故 L1/L2 取 家居日用/防护，未选 医药保健。已剥离：全部医疗与外科措辞、过滤与阻隔宣称及数字（三层阻隔、阻隔大颗粒/微颗粒、静电吸附、防漏气防雾气、不致敏、0黏胶 0甲醛、上万排气孔）、细菌病毒与雾霾危害儿童健康等病理恐惧文案、规格与尺寸数字（30P、50只/包、145x90mm、保质期2年）、品牌与店招、二维码与「加入会员全店免费」角标、并排翻页箭头与尖括号导航控件；相关文案一律脱敏为 {selling_point_*}/{callout_*} 占位符，参数卡数值槽留白待真实资料后期合成，noDrift 与每条 Negative 均明确禁用上述内容，未编造任何认证或检测数据。佩戴镜人物统一背向并仅露后脑与肩部，未出现医疗场景与医护人员。与库内既有 3D 鱼嘴柳叶口罩模版的差异：平面三折满版印花款 vs 立体鱼嘴壳体纯白款；暖粉糖果圆角色块＋实心图标＋圆体字 vs 冷蓝渐变展台＋细线圆环图标＋几何无衬线；4300K 前右柔光投影向左 vs 6000K 顶左光带光斑；文字色深墨绿松石 #2E4F5A 与珊瑚玫 #EE6E85 vs 深炭 #2D2D2D 与深蓝 #1668C8；本套另含花色平铺、产品参数卡与使用须知收口三镜，未复用其结构与构图。
